description: Defines the AAudioServiceInterface class as an abstract interface for audio service operations in the Android AAudio framework, including methods for stream management, client registration, and thread control.

classes.name: AAudioServiceInterface
classes.description: An abstract interface class providing methods for managing audio streams and clients in the Android AAudio system.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers an IAAudioClient with the audio service.

methods.name: openStream
methods.description: Opens a new audio stream with specified request parameters and returns stream handle info.

methods.name: closeStream
methods.description: Closes an existing audio stream identified by stream handle info.

methods.name: getStreamDescription
methods.description: Retrieves an immutable description of the in-memory queues used for communication with the HAL or Service.

methods.name: startStream
methods.description: Starts data flow on the specified stream.

methods.name: pauseStream
methods.description: Pauses data flow on the specified stream.

methods.name: stopStream
methods.description: Stops data flow after current buffer is played.

methods.name: flushStream
methods.description: Discards any data held by the HAL or Service for the specified stream.

methods.name: registerAudioThread
methods.description: Registers a thread as a low latency audio thread.

methods.name: unregisterAudioThread
methods.description: Unregisters a thread from low latency audio processing.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Starts an audio client on a specified stream.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Stops an audio client on a specified stream.

methods.name: exitStandby
methods.description: Exits standby mode for a stream and updates data queue info.
